note: the artefact behind the prose numbers of §4 Robustness. The alignment convention is the one in explore_fusion_gains.py (common keys = XGB and the five backbones, mask = the intersection over all branches).

global_w_dev.note: w fitted on the whole OOF set and evaluated on that same OOF set - a development estimate.

global_w_nested.note: w fitted on the four folds that exclude the evaluation fold - removes selection optimism.

fixed_w_0.5.note: the two branches averaged with equal weight, nothing fitted.

per_point_w_nested.note: a separate w fitted at each of the 52 field locations, nested.

nnls_stack_nested.note: a per-location non-negative least-squares stack (normalised to sum to one), nested.

per_eye_advantage.model: fusion (XGB + the mean of the five CNN backbones), nested global w

vs_cnn_ensemble.comparator: the mean of the five CNN backbones

per_eye_advantage.note: paired Wilcoxon on the per-eye RMSE. A negative delta = fusion wins.
